definitions.gloss: only; just; merely; no more than
definitions.explanation: Emphasizes that something is limited to a small amount, short time, or few items. Often conveys surprise or disappointment at how small or few something is.

examples.japanese: たった{百円|ひゃくえん}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{買|か}えた→買う：00489_kau⟧。
examples.english: I was able to buy it for just 100 yen.

examples.japanese: たった⟦{一人|ひとり}→一人：00630_hitori⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{全部|ぜんぶ}→全部：02888_zenbu⟧⟦やった→やる：02980_yaru⟧。
examples.english: I did it all by myself alone.
examples.notes: [Note: たった一人 = all alone, just one person]

examples.japanese: ⟦{会議|かいぎ}→会議：00710_kaigi⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧たった⟦{十分|じゅっぷん}→十分：09572_juppun⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{終|お}わった→終わる：00567_owaru⟧。
examples.english: The meeting ended in just ten minutes.

examples.japanese: たった⟦{三日|みっか}→三日：02969_mikka⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{日本語|にほんご}→日本語：00614_nihongo⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{覚|おぼ}える→覚える：00739_oboeru⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{無理|むり}→無理：01558_muri⟧⟦だ→だ：09496_da⟧。
examples.english: It's impossible to learn Japanese in just three days.

examples.japanese: ⟦{彼|かれ}→彼：01292_kare⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧たった⟦{二年|にねん}→二年：28862_ninen⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{会社|かいしゃ}→会社：00607_kaisha⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{大|おお}きくして→大きい：00335_ookii⟧、⟦{今|いま}→今：00945_ima⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{百人|ひゃくにん}→百人：10985_hyakunin⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{社員|しゃいん}→社員：03065_shain⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦いる→いる：00495_iru⟧。
examples.english: He grew the company in just two years, and now it has a hundred employees.

notes:
WRITING: Usually written in hiragana. Can be written as ⟦{唯|ただ}→ただ：01613_tada⟧ but this is rare.

USAGE: Emphasizes smallness of quantity, time, or number. Often expresses:
- Surprise at how little/few
- Loneliness or isolation (たった⟦{一人|ひとり}→一人：00630_hitori⟧)
- Quick completion (たった〜⟦で→で：00502_de⟧)

COMMON PATTERNS:
- たった + number/counter
- たった⟦{今|いま}→今：00945_ima⟧ (just now)
- たった⟦{一|ひと}つ→一つ：02948_hitotsu⟧ (only one)
- たった⟦{一人|ひとり}→一人：00630_hitori⟧ (all alone)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦ただ→ただ：01613_tada⟧ (only, just - less emphatic)
- ⟦わずか→わずか：03792_wazuka⟧ (only, merely - more formal)
- ⟦ほんの→ほんの：22755_honno⟧ (just, only a little)
- ⟦{僅|わず}か→わずか：03792_wazuka⟧ (only, merely)
